description: Compute the normalized unique-weight MST of a connected undirected simple graph.

contract.operation: Return a deterministic hash encoding the normalized MST edges and their total weight.
contract.edge_count: 0 for a one-vertex graph; otherwise vertex_count-1 through vertex_count*(vertex_count-1)/2
contract.graph: connected, undirected, and simple; no self-loops or repeated unordered endpoint pair
contract.edge_orientation_and_input_order: do not affect the normalized MST result
contract.output: low 63 bits of FNV-1a-64 over vertex_count:u16, mst_edge_count:u16, normalized (u:u16,v:u16,weight:i32) records in ascending weight order, then total_weight:i64; all fields little-endian

input.edge_count_range: 0 when vertex_count=1; otherwise vertex_count-1 through vertex_count*(vertex_count-1)/2

output.encoding: vertex_count:u16le, mst_edge_count:u16le, each normalized (u:u16le,v:u16le,weight:i32le) sorted by weight, total_weight:i64le
